title: False New Year: True Past Curses & Trauma

sense.text:
The new year does not begin in January. The Lord told Israel when it begins: “This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.” This is the eve of the false new year, and the truth of when the year begins comes first.

The months the Lord gave us run Abib, Zif, and on through to Adar. Babylon renamed them: Abib became Nisan, and Tammuz is a Babylonian name. Rome renamed them again, and the Roman calendar does not even make sense on its own terms. August was first Sextilis, six. September is from sept, seven, like septuplets. October is from oct, eight, like an octagon, an octopus with eight arms, Octavius the eighth born. November is from novem, nine. December is from dec, ten, like decimal, decade, decalogue. Yet September is called the ninth month, October the tenth, November the eleventh, December the twelfth. Count from March, the way the year truly runs, and January is the eleventh month and February the twelfth.

January is named for Janus, the two-headed god of beginnings and endings, one face looking forward and one looking behind. He is the god of endings and beginnings because Rome knew January was the end of the year, and marked it as the beginning anyway. Julius Caesar established that new year.

So when you sit around celebrating the new year, you are worshipping Rome. Almost all the months carry Roman names, the days of the week carry Roman names, the planets are named after Roman gods, and even midnight as the start of the day is Roman ideology.

precepts.why:
The first month has a name: “This day came ye out in the month Abib.” The month Israel came out of Egypt is the month the Lord made the beginning of months.

Abib falls between late March and early April. Every two or three years the year runs longer and it comes later, into mid or late April, but commonly it is late March and early April. That is when the new year actually begins according to the word of God, not the first of January.

sense.text:
“And he shall speak great words against the most High”: the he is the so-called European man, the so-called white man today. He “shall wear out the saints of the most High.”

“And think to change times and laws.” It says think because the truth comes out through the prophets that the times and laws he thought to change are a lie. You cannot change times and laws. The sun and moon remain; they still stand. Those ordinances are forever. He only thought to change them while our people were in darkness.

“And they shall be given into his hand”: this whole class turns on us being given into his hands and taught his doctrines, his indoctrination. “Until a time and times and the dividing of time”: that is the 350 years in which we would be in complete and utter darkness and oblivion of who we are.

This beast John saw rising up is America. “Like unto a leopard”: America adopted Greek philosophy, and the very politics America is founded upon come from Greece; democracy was founded in Greece.

“His feet were as the feet of a bear”: that is Persia, Medo-Persia, a duality of rulership. In America it is democrat and republican, played against each other, but the same power, one stronger and dominating the other. It is an illusion.

“His mouth as the mouth of a lion”: that is Babylon. America took Babylonian ideals into itself, in its holidays and festivities, because Rome adopted many Babylonian practices: the dark moon is Babylonian, New Year's is Babylonian, Easter and Christmas are Babylonian. The European power structure today learned from every mistake of the past Near Eastern civilizations, and where they failed, it has succeeded.

“And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” The dragon is the devil, the spiritual entity Satan himself. He gave this beast his power, his seat of rulership over this world, and great authority over it. Satan is behind the rulership of the men of this world, and the European power structure that reigns supreme today does it by the power of Satan himself. That is why so many of our people blindly follow and worship this man to the fullest extent of their ability.

“One of his heads as it were wounded to death” is Rome. Rome was almost wounded to death: under Septimius Severus the Israelites conquered Rome and reigned over it for a time. But even with black folks reigning over Rome, we kept the same Roman ideals, ideologies and politics. It was black faces following European ideals, and nothing changed. So “his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast”: the world follows after the European Union.

“And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”: a lot of our people, believe it or not, worship Satan, the devil. “And they worshipped the beast”: we worship the so-called white man that Satan gave his power to, and the god the white man serves, like Caesar, which is of Satan.

“Saying, Who is like unto the beast?” Tell black folks it is not New Year's and they say, who are you? What's wrong with celebrating Christ's birth? We know it's not his birthday, but we do it anyway, what's the big deal? They do it because the white man told them to. When their worship and customs are questioned, they are really asking: who can tell us what we can and can't do but the white man?

“Who is able to make war with him?” That is the mindset of many of our people and of the nations: this man is unconquerable and undefeated. He rules and reigns, he makes nuclear weapons, he has the most powerful military on the earth, he is able to make it where a man can have his penis cut down the middle and turned into a vagina, and a woman's clitoris extended and turned into a penis. The white man is God on this earth, so when he makes up a holiday, why not honor it? Who are you to tell me it ain't the new year, or it's not Christmas? Who can argue his doctrines, his God of three personalities in one, one what and three whos? Who can argue his exegesis, his eisegesis, his hermeneutics, his theology schools? Did you go to seminary?

It has reached the Israelites. New camps rising up, young, with no elders, orphan camps, using the same rhetoric and talking points as the white man's apologetics and hermeneutics, running to the Greek for a word (I don't give a damn about the Greek word), with four different Bibles at one camp, reading the ESV, instead of precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little, there a little. That is a sign of fear and unbelief, Israelites dancing to the tune of the white man and his ideologies, Snapple-top fun-fact teachers. Israelites wearing Khazar tassels now; after a while they will be converts. The so-called white man in Israel will be the real Jew, not Esau but Japheth. We will be learning Eurocentric Hebrew, with bar mitzvahs, yarmulkes and prayer shawls on Israelites.

Why? Because as the devil mobilizes, a spirit in these Israelites tells them to adapt before the heat is turned up: start saying nations can be saved, there are some good ones; start saying the nations will judge us in the kingdom, get eternal bodies and enter the gates. Ask them what gate Abraham goes through, and the answer is the Judah gate. Adam, Seth, Abel, Noah, Abraham and Isaac go through the Judah gate. Y'all are out of your minds, playing games, trying to open up the doors to the enemy. Many mean well, but the road to hell is paved with good intentions: whatever the intent of the doctrine, it leads to the same place.

It is the same with the books added to the Bible downloads on your phones, Enoch and Jubilees, talking about angels coming down and having sex with women, angels turning into planets. That's Transformers, that's Unicron, ain't no damn Bible. It contradicts the Bible entirely; it is madness. Esau put them there to bring confusion to our people, and the rest of the books are hidden in the Vatican in ancient languages only the scholars and high-ups can read. The young should leave those books alone and hold fast to what we have. The little we have is enough to inherit the kingdom of heaven, enough to hold us until Christ comes back. Yet the white man says this is a book too, and who is like unto the beast?

“And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies”: this is the same mouth that speaks great words against the most High and thinks to change times and laws in Daniel 7:25. He says the new moon is a black moon, and the month starts when there is no light at all. But the moon is called a great light along with the sun. How is there an unseen moon? Research the new moon as a dark moon and it takes you back to the pagan societies: the Babylonians, the Greeks, the Romans, the Arabs. Not Israel.

The blasphemies are that they are the real Jew, the people of the book, and we are the Gentiles; that they are the Christians, the anointed of God, and we are the savages, the infidels.

“And power was given unto him to continue forty and two months”: that is the same as the time and times and the dividing of time in Daniel, the 350 years.

“And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God.” Against God how? Against God's time, his year, his new year, his feast days, his people, his son, his angels, his prophets: against God in all spectrums, even the Bible. The King James says we would be brought into bondage in ships and sold. Then in the 1970s the white man revised it to say they will sell themselves into slavery for nothing and no one will buy them. What nation sells itself into slavery for free, with no man to buy them?

Israelites resort to those Bibles out of fear. They have already started dividing us; the SPLC already says it: Hebrew Israelites, and radical Hebrew Israelites. The radical ones say Christ is a black man, the nations are going into slavery, America is going to be burned. The good ones wear tzitzit and say the nations are going to be saved; those, they will leave alone for now. But he is going to destroy both. It is a setup.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints.” How was it given unto him? Because we gave him the opportunity. We broke our God's commandments and his laws and gave the nations opportunity to strike and be successful. That is the whole point of this class. Normally when they made war with us, we destroyed them without fail; it was easy work. But the Most High said, not this time. This time I am not going to protect you; you are on your own against him. And we lost.

“And to overcome them”: to overcome us and teach us his changed times and laws, to worship him, to see only him as God and his as the angels, and to accept his blasphemies, his theology and ideologies, as truth.

When he went into Africa, colonizing it and enslaving us, that was war, and we lost the war and became the slaves. The slave owners gave their captains instructions as to which African ethnic group was preferred. The white man was not snatching up random black people on a huge continent; with the help of the Arabs and the Hamites he knew exactly who he was looking for. He went after that people because, left there, we would still be teaching that we are the children of Israel, so that had to go.

“And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.” Power was given him not only to conquer us but to conquer everybody, all the dark nations.

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him.” All nations in some capacity worship the white man: his weaponry, his religion, his politics, his philosophies. Especially the two-thirds of our own.

“Whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.” The nations are not found in the book of life, and the two-thirds of our people are not found in that book either.

History is not linear; it loops. The same prophets that were around of old are around today. The same Romans are around today. The same turncoats and traitors and nation lovers who allied themselves with the nations and fought against their own people are around today, and so are those who fought against the system, the revolutionaries.

The elite would track bloodlines to stop them before they wake up, but they cannot stop a thing. God said they are coming back, and they come right back. Drugs, cocaine and crack in our neighborhoods did damage but did not kill the prophets. Mass incarceration and the mass murder of our people did not stop the revolution; the turbulent sixties still happened despite all the atrocities. That spark has always been there, and they can never put it out fully.

“I will liken my judgment unto a ring”: what we go through is not new. It has happened before: same people, same situation. “Like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first”: what happened in the past happens all over again, like a ring, a cycle, a clock, again and again.

Times don't change; the influencers do, and the same influencers that were around back then are around today under different names and titles. Rather than Rome, it is America now. Rather than Israelites or Jews, it is African-Americans now, Hispanics, illegal aliens. Nothing different.

This is the nail in the coffin for who Israel is historically. After this, there should be no doubt who Israel is and who Israel is not, and no confusion. Whoever still thinks we are Gentiles after this is just two-thirds.

“If thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.” The covenant came with conditions: do what I say and I will bless you; reject what I say and I will curse you. We chose the hard way. We chose not to listen, and we chose the consequences.

“Cursed shalt thou be in the city”: the city is our living conditions. Ghettos, slums, barrios, shack towns: Detroit, Cali, New York, Maryland, Memphis, Chicago, Brooklyn. Deplorable conditions, poverty, drugs, crime, death, low education, low income, trash all over the place, gangs all over the place.

It was the same in Spain, Portugal and Italy. Ghettos are nothing new. They had us in ghettos all the way back in Spain and Portugal, redlined: you Jews stay over there. And once we were confined to the ghettos they passed laws so we could not bear arms, or made it very hard to get one. Nothing new under the sun; time loops. When the so-called Jews today say they were in ghettos, we were in the ghettos, not them.

“And cursed shalt thou be in the field”: the cotton fields, tobacco, indigo, rice, silk, sugarcane and coffee fields. There was no rest for the weary. Work began at sunrise and ended late at night, twenty hours out of twenty-four, in rain, sleet and snow; the horses got more breaks than we did. It started as soon as a child could walk, two and three years old. At the African Burial Ground in New York there are skeletons of three-year-old children with their bones worn down to nothing. If you can walk, you can work.

Even the so-called lenient slaveholder gave four days off for Christmas, and that was to make sure we retained that doctrine: we got the time off, so we reverenced it. I love Christmas, that's the day we don't have to work in the field; I love Sunday. That is where it comes from.

Solomon Northup told it: in the cotton field as soon as it was light, ten or fifteen minutes at noon to swallow cold bacon, then working until it was too dark to see, and when the moon was full, often until the middle of the night. Living in want in the midst of plenty: much land, fruit, berries and a big house, and we got cold bacon. That is cursed in the field.

And yet some Israelites try to save these nations. Nothing is despised more than that: after things like this, y'all that try to save the nations are comfortable here, and you're going to die here.

“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people”: that is us being auctioned off. “And thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long”: you would watch your children given to somebody else and long for them. “And there shall be no might in thine hand”: no might to get them back. When we were taken from Africa the children were sold, and when we got here the same was done, and there was no power on the auction block to get our kids back.

Black childhood was stolen. By age ten, and younger, children were on their way to a life of servitude, following their parents into the fields or the big house. The white playmates became slaveholders and the black children became slaves. The lessons came by the lash, by the runaway captured and brought back, and by the cry of a black mother as another child was separated from her and sold. That is Deuteronomy 28: your children sold into captivity.

Even so, the children rebelled. That spark was there in the young Israelites who took the slave ship Amistad, and in the young slaves who ran off to the Union camps, preferring bayonets and gunfire to the whip.

The children learned that black men were powerless to protect them, and that is what affects our women today: they feel the black man is powerless to protect them. A black woman joining the feminist mentality is cutting with a double-edged sword, turning against us when we were both in the same situation: she powerless to protect her child, he powerless to protect her and himself. The world made a distinction between white and black, favoring the one and despising the other, and it still does.

In 12 Years a Slave, Eliza is sold with Solomon, and her son Randall is sold away from her, made to jump and run like a fine beast, the way our men jump for them in sports today. Her little girl is held back because there is money to be made from her. That is a live example of verse 32, no might in thine hand. Eliza weeps for her children, saying they are as her flesh. Under the circumstances Ford is one of the good ones, but he is still a slaver.

Racial anger is necessary for this truth. That does not mean violence. Our elders taught that to teach sufficiently you must have a certain level of anger in your heart for your people's condition and what was done to us, and channel it through the word of God, teaching with power and fierceness the way the elders did who came up right after slavery and saw it. Without it you are only parroting, a comfortable passive orphan-camp teacher who adapts. The ones with that fire, that zeal, the revolutionary spirit come back today, are who Esau fears most.

Christ is coming back to take vengeance for what was done to us, and part of the gospel is vengeance. We do not want reparations; giving money to broken people with slave trauma flowing through their veins is out of your mind. If someone raped your daughter and offered fifty million dollars to forget it, only a sellout or an unjust person would take it. Some of you foundational ones would take it, because you were always here. We want justice, and vengeance is divine justice, not money. Money can't fix broken people; the Bible fixes us.

“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”: for those who did not lose their children, this is colonization. A nation moves into your land and takes your resources, and you get nothing out of it.

In Malawi, known for its tea, the men who work the tea fields on their own land get next to nothing; a brother at the hotel made a hundred and something dollars a month, and a tip of a few dollars lasted him a whole month. The East Indians, the Chinese and the Japanese today are neo-colonizers. The so-called Chinese, Moab, move into the Caribbean, marry the women who have land, and monopolize it. The white man does it in Malawi and Sierra Leone. Even in Harlem the soul food spots are owned by Moab with Jacob as the chefs. Moab and Edom are on video slapping our people in the Caribbean and in West Africa, and our people allow it. Why? Who is like unto the beast?

“Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” Your children would be snatched up and taken from you and sold off to the highest bidder.

In Roots, the auctioneer sells a young woman by promising she will raise the buyer a fine litter of pickaninnies; our grandparents still said that word because they heard it from theirs. The one born and trained to hold her still for the sale is the house Israelite today who wants to save the nations, the podcaster and content creator, and the merchants doing the bidding are the non-radical Israelites.

Kunta Kinte prided himself on being Mandinka, of the same lineage as Mansa Musa. His wife answered: I ain't no African, I'm American, I was born here, my mama and my daddy and my daddy's daddy were born here. She sounds like those today who say we were always here. Then their daughter Kizzy was sold, and the same woman was on her hands and knees begging the master in the name of Jesus, white Jesus at this point, to beat her child raw, anything, only not to sell her. That is the condition of our people.

Going back to the judgment being like a ring: “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee.” It says pursue because we tried to run from the curses. We ran to Spain, to Italy, to Britain, and wherever we ran the same curses followed: slavery, colonization, children sold off, enslaved, killed. Nothing changed. God said these curses would follow us and overtake us “till thou be destroyed”, brought to the lowest state.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” These are generational curses, not one-time curses, for all the asinine apologetics who ask what curses. They are constant. Upon thy seed means they repeat: when you are dead and gone, the same curse that fell upon you falls upon your kids and your kids' kids.

For ever means until the Lord says enough. To us it is five hundred years; to the Lord it is a few seconds.

Lest we forget, because black folks are forgetful: the ship captains sailed for Africa carrying a route map to the slave coast and insurance papers. If a slave died, or the cargo, which was us, was thrown overboard or taken by pirates, the owner got reimbursed, because we were property; losing us didn't mean much. The ship Sally was owned by the DeWolf family of Bristol, operators of a quarter of Rhode Island's slaving ventures, and the Wolf name is big in the music industry today. The same families that owned slaves own record labels, which means they still own slaves, because these rappers and celebrities are still slaves.

precepts.why:
This is nothing new. “And the merchants of the country, hearing the fame of them, took silver and gold very much, with servants, and came into the camp to buy the children of Israel for slaves.” They came to buy the children of Israel for slaves: that is an auction.

“A power also of Syria and of the land of the Philistines joined themselves unto them”, joined to buy us. Our sons and daughters given unto another people did not start in America; the auction block for our people goes back to the Greeks.

The same sale, with more detail. Nicanor was sent “with no fewer than twenty thousand of all nations under him, to root out the whole generation of the Jews”: twenty thousand men to eradicate our nation from the earth, “and with him he joined also Gorgias a captain, who in matters of war had great experience.”

“So Nicanor undertook to make so much money of the captive Jews, as should defray the tribute of two thousand talents, which the king was to pay to the Romans.” He planned to pay that tribute by selling us as slaves. So “he sent to the cities upon the sea coast, proclaiming a sale of the captive Jews, and promising that they should have fourscore and ten bodies for one talent”: ninety of our bodies for one talent.

“Not expecting the vengeance that was to follow upon him from the Almighty God.” That is justice. Read on to verse 22: Judas Maccabeus joined with himself his own brethren, “Simon, and Joseph, and Jonathan, giving each one fifteen hundred men. Also he appointed Eleazar to read the holy book”, and gave them the watchword, “The help of God”. “And by the help of the Almighty they slew above nine thousand of their enemies, and wounded and maimed the most part of Nicanor’s host, and so put all to flight”, “And took their money that came to buy them.” We robbed the people who came to the auction, with the very money they brought to buy us.

And in verse 34, “that most ungracious Nicanor, who had brought a thousand merchants to buy the Jews”. A thousand merchants brought to buy us at the auction. The auction block for our people is not new; the Greeks did it, and white folks have been trying to sell us for the longest. And the answer to it then was what the answer is now: not payment, but the vengeance of the Almighty God.
